# Support

EmotionSense AI is currently an engineering foundation and does not provide a functional emotional-reflection service.

## Project Support

- Use the issue templates for reproducible defects, documentation problems, and scoped proposals.
- Read the [contribution guide](../docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) before submitting work.
- Use GitHub Discussions for general questions only after repository maintainers enable and moderate Discussions.
- Do not include personal recordings, emotional-reflection content, biometric data, credentials, proprietary datasets, or other sensitive information.

Maintainers provide support on a best-effort basis. No service-level or response-time commitment is offered for general questions.

## Security and Privacy Reports

Do not open a public issue for vulnerabilities, exposed credentials, privacy incidents, or sensitive reproduction evidence. Follow the private process in the [security policy](../SECURITY.md).

## Community Conduct

Report conduct concerns privately as described in the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Do not publish incident details in an issue or discussion.

## Health and Emergency Disclaimer

EmotionSense AI is not a medical device, clinical service, crisis resource, or emergency-response service. It does not diagnose, treat, prevent, or monitor mental health conditions. If you or another person may be in immediate danger, contact local emergency services or an appropriate qualified professional.
